description: This file defines the ServerConfig class for etcd, including configuration parameters, validation methods, and directory path helpers. It is a core configuration source file for etcd server setup.

classes.name: ServerConfig
classes.description: Holds configuration parameters for an etcd server instance, including validation and directory path helpers.

methods.name: VerifyBootstrap
methods.description: Sanity-checks the initial configuration for bootstrap.

methods.name: VerifyJoinExisting
methods.description: Sanity-checks the configuration for joining an existing cluster.

methods.name: hasLocalMember
methods.description: Checks if the local server is part of the initial cluster configuration.

methods.name: advertiseMatchesCluster
methods.description: Confirms that peer URLs match cluster configuration.

methods.name: MemberDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path for member data.

methods.name: WALDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path for write-ahead logs.

methods.name: SnapDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path for snapshots.

methods.name: ShouldDiscover
methods.description: Indicates if discovery is enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: PeerDialTimeout
methods.description: Calculates the peer dial timeout duration.

methods.name: CheckDuplicateURL
methods.description: Checks for duplicate URLs in the cluster configuration.

methods.name: BackendPath
methods.description: Returns the backend database file path.

methods.name: MaxRequestBytesWithOverhead
methods.description: Returns the maximum request size including gRPC overhead.
